items.name: Aberrant Fabric
items.description: A piece of fabric of unknown origin, worn by the members of a cult that wishes for the return of the Ancient.

items.name: Abhorrent Long Axe
items.description: A long axe anchored with an abiotic core, spreading ruin, fear and silence.

items.name: Abiotic Core
items.description: An artificial mechanism that can control an organic brain, amplifying its capabilities enough to manipulate the physical world that surrounds it.

items.name: Absolute Zero
items.description:
"The coldest material ever forged makes up an armor that not only is incredibly resilient, but will FREEZE enemies on contact.
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn."

items.name: Abyssal Compendium
items.description: A book listing forgotten techniques of spellweaving, learned from eldritch entities at a great price.

items.name: Abyssal Cutlass
items.description: A variation of the typical Cutlass, forged using an enhanced metal to make it lighter.

items.name: Abyssal Goo
items.description: Viscous potion that can enhance some base materials with additional, terrifying properties.

items.name: Abyssal Greataxe
items.description: A colossal greataxe forged in the abyss, its edge drinks the light.

items.name: Abyssal Ingot
items.description: A black Iron ingot blessed with eldritch properties from the depth of the abyss.

items.name: Abyssal Scarlet Mantle
items.description: An awe-inspiring mantle saturated with Ancestral Blood from the deepest abyss. Its suffocating crimson aura elevates all mortal faculties to mythical heights, delivering cataclysmic critical strikes.

items.name: Abyssal Seashell
items.description: Large seashell found in the north-western seas. Mostly used as decoration, possesses some interesting properties.

items.name: Aegis
items.description:
"An ancient artifact of unknown origin, held by the heroes who wish to protect the weak. Will taunt enemies for 2 turns on hit.
TAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target"

items.name: Aegis Mechanica
items.description:
"Enhanced with mechanical parts taken by a mysterious, ancient creature. This unique artifact will change its shape by pressing a small trigger on its hilt, and is able to reach far away targets. Will taunt enemies for 2 turns on hit.
TAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target"

items.name: Aether Ignis
items.description: Flammable liquid used to make flight possible for the heavy flying ships of the Celestial Army.

items.name: Alchemic Powder
items.description: The mysterious substance responsible of infusing life into the titans roaming the cultists lair. The origin seems organic.

items.name: Algae
items.description: "Thin, greenish-brown plant that lives underwater. Its taste is salty and briny, and it's used mostly for exotic recipe typical of seaside settlements."

items.name: Alpha Wolf Fang
items.description: A partitularly long tooth, once belonging to the leader of a pack of wolves.

items.name: Ambrosia
items.description: "A golden ethereal drink, extremely sweet and with a caloric intake which is off the charts. The way it's produced is unknown, but is sometimes carried from unknown lands by the traveling merchants."

items.name: Amulet of Resurrection
items.description: Made from the feathers of a legendary bird, in case of death this amulet will resurrect its owner with full HP and no negative effect, possibly forever.

items.name: Amulet of the Swordsman
items.description: An amulet that allows the wearer to see through it as if it was an additional eye. Gives a new perspective on the fight, allowing for superior decision making.

items.name: Ancestral Blood
items.description: Blood drawn from Lazarus, the first vampire.

items.name: Ancient Armor
items.description: Extremely durable armor made with the hardest known metal, lined with remains of prehistoric giants.

items.name: Ancient Boots
items.description: Boots sewn together using the resistant and flexible hide of prehistoric giants.

items.name: Ancient Eye
items.description: A gift from a nameless horror.

items.name: Ancient Gloves
items.description: Gloves sewn together using the resistant and flexible hide of prehistoric giants.

items.name: Ancient Hide
items.description: Scale covered hide of a giant, archaic beast living at the center of the world.

items.name: Ancient Jacket
items.description: Extremely versatile jacket made with the remains of prehistoric giants.

items.name: Ancient Membrane
items.description: An incredibly durable yet lightweight membrane, taken from the wing of a creature believed to have gone extinct millions of years ago.

items.name: Ancient Robe
items.description: Extremely light robe made with the remains of a prehistoric wing.

items.name: Ancient Seed
items.description: A hardened, very old seed that seems to possess magical properties.

items.name: Angelfish
items.description: A delicate angelfish, perfect for pampered pets.

items.name: Animated Axe
items.description: Axe made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.

items.name: Animated Bow
items.description: Bow made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.

items.name: Animated Buckler
items.description: Round shield made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.

items.name: Animated Cuirass
items.description: Heavy armor made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.

items.name: Animated Dagger
items.description: Dagger made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.

items.name: Animated Helm
items.description: Helm made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.

items.name: Animated Ingot
items.description: Metal ingot smelted from pieces of Living Metal.

items.name: Animated Scraps
items.description: Pieces of an unknown metal. They move erratically when left alone, and pulsate with an eerie light.

items.name: Animated Staff
items.description: Staff made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.

items.name: Animated Sword
items.description: Sword made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.

items.name: Apple
items.description: Round and glossy, with skin colors ranging from red to yellow. It’s crisp, juicy, and sweet, with a slight tartness.

items.name: Apple Pie
items.description: A golden, flaky crust surrounds a soft, spiced apple filling. It’s sweet and slightly tart, with cinnamon adding warmth to the juicy, tender apples.

items.name: Arcane Dagger
items.description: Exclusive blade gifted from the Seer to its assassins, able to pierce even the thickest steel.

items.name: Archaic Amulet
items.description: "A fiery gem embedded in this pendant attracts wildlife, enhancing the holder's empathy and connection with animals they're close with. Grants Animal Affinity, which increases the damage of living creatures controlled by 1% for each point."

items.name: Archmage Hat
items.description: "Extremely powerful, magic-enhancing artifact worn only by Laroxian's Council members."

items.name: Armor of the Dryad
items.description: Incorporates a single, long Dryad hair that works as a powerful, permanent healing spell.

items.name: Armor of the Undying
items.description: A forbidden artifact used to defy death merged with ancient, cursed metal. Serves as a decoy for the life of the wearer, restoring it with an enhanced version of the regular status every time they are hurt.

items.name: Ascended Bow
items.description:
"The power of thunder has been infused into this bow, to enhance its disruptive capabilities.
STUN: the unit skips its turn"

items.name: Astral Goo
items.description: "A chunk of a giant, nightmarish monster that surpasses a mortal's wildest fantasy. You are not sure of its utility."

items.name: Avian Egg
items.description: Egg that will hatch an Avian pet. Avian pets usually like to attract enemy attention, distracting them from the party.

items.name: Avocado
items.description: It has a smooth, dark green skin with a creamy, buttery flesh inside. It’s mild and rich in fats, with a subtle, nutty flavor. Complements some of the most exotic, fish based recipes.

items.name: Bag of Choking Powder
items.description: A bag of irritant powder that Giant Moth wings are covered in. It allows for a more aerodynamic flight, but irritates the airways of most other living beings.

items.name: Banana
items.description: Yellow, sweet fruit found in tropical lands. Monkeys love them, even ones employed by the Skull Island fleet.

items.name: Banshee Bow
items.description: Uses two giant claws as the frame, granting extreme flexibility and resistance to tension.

items.name: Banshee Claw
items.description: The sharp and resilient claw of a Banshee

items.name: Banshee Dagger
items.description: Short knife build from a Banshee claw, which takes advantage of the very sharp edge to inflict tremendous damage.

items.name: Banshee Gloves
items.description: Made from Banshee scales grafted together. Allows for superior protection while granting a great range of movements.

items.name: Banshee Horn
items.description: Twisted, black horn of a Banshee

items.name: Banshee Jacket
items.description: "Made of resilient Banshee scales, one of the hardest known organic materials that can bend enough to not reduce the wearer's mobility too much."

items.name: Banshee Scale
items.description: Hard scale making up the skin of a Banshee

items.name: Banshee Scream
items.description: Extremely resistant bow that integrates a piece of alien technology, granting the archer an enhanced ability to hit vital points.

items.name: Bat Tooth
items.description: Frontal tooth of a Vampire Bat. Sometimes used as alchemic ingredient.

items.name: Bat Wing
items.description: The resilient wing of a Vampire Bat.

items.name: Beastmaster Jacket
items.description: Elite armor embedding several fiery gems. It has a great versatility in combat, and grants increased control on domesticated creatures. Grants Animal Affinity, which increases the damage of living creatures controlled by 1% for each point.

items.name: Beast Pelt
items.description: The pelt of a wild animals, usually refined to make Leather.

items.name: Belt Jacket
items.description: Crafted from the belts in use by the Golden City Wardens, this equipment is surprisingly resilient despite its improvised nature.

items.name: Berserker's Axe
items.description: A brutal axe wielded by the fierce warriors of the Lost Lands, driving relentless onslaughts.

items.name: Black Hide
items.description: The skin of a horrible monster preying in the dark.

items.name: Black Iron Armor
items.description: "Very hard plates made with the pirate's Black Iron make this armor difficult to break."

items.name: Black Iron Axe
items.description: A heavy axe hewn from black iron, reinforced with spectral wood.

items.name: Black Iron Cutlass
items.description: A curved blade commonly wielded by Skull Island pirates.

items.name: Black Iron Dagger
items.description: "Knife made with the pirate's Black Iron."

items.name: Black Iron Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets made of disjointed plates of Black Iron.

items.name: Black Iron Helm
items.description: Resistant helm made with Black Iron.

items.name: Black Iron Ingot
items.description: "Extremely resistant metal alloy. It's formula is jealously guarded by the pirate blacksmiths."

items.name: Black Iron Scepter
items.description: Crafted with the most popular iron variation among the pirates, this staff is well balanced and allows magic to flow within with little resistance.

items.name: Black Iron Scraps
items.description: Scraps of the famed metal, ready to be fused into an ingot.

items.name: Black Ooze
items.description: A dense, sticky black substance. It is believed to be a byproduct of the soul-stealing process from the eldritch gods.

items.name: Bleak Boots
items.description: Boots made from unknown materials, glowing with an evil light and blessed by an ancient power.

items.name: Bleak Gloves
items.description: Gloves made from unknown materials, glowing with an evil light and blessed by an ancient power.

items.name: Bloodstone Claws
items.description:
"Gloves forged with ancient iron, infused with crystalline bloodstone and forged with scarlet debris. Vibrates in a frenzied cadence that allows the wearer to cut through flesh with lethal speed. The attack has to be melee for the effect to take place.
BLEED: the target receives 1 damage at the start of its turn for every charge, then removes one charge"

items.name: Blueberry
items.description: Small and round, deep blue or purple in color. Usually found in the colder mountain trails, it has a slightly tart flavors, and leaves a mildly floral aftertaste.

items.name: Blueberry Pancake
items.description: A fluffy, golden-brown pancake dotted with juicy blueberries. It’s soft and sweet, with bursts of tart blueberry flavor in each bite.

items.name: Blueberry Smoothie
items.description: A thick, purple blend of blueberries and creamy ingredients. This recipe is not commonly found, as the few blueberries brought back from the troll ridden mountains were reserved for kings and princes.

items.name: Blue Shark
items.description: A hefty blue shark — a true feast for any pet.

items.name: Blue Trout
items.description: A blue trout pulled from the Slumbering Shallows.

items.name: Boar Tusk
items.description: A well preserved tusk from a wild boar.

items.name: Bone Fragment
items.description: Fragments of a bone once belonging to a valiant soldier.

items.name: Bottled Sand Spirit
items.description: A powerful Djinn spirit trapped in a bottle.

items.name: Bread
items.description: "A soft, golden-brown crust gives way to a fluffy, airy interior. It's one of the most common foods in the Realms, enjoyed by paesants, soldiers and nobles alike."

items.name: Breathtaking Robe
items.description:
"A robe made with the wings of a Giant Moth treated to increase the normal amount of choking powder present by several orders of magnitude. Causes swelling in the airways of enemies getting too close, SILENCING them for 2 turns.
SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana"

items.name: Burning Censer
items.description: An otherworldly candle encased in a metal support, anointed with oils that display healing properties.

items.name: Burning Effigy
items.description: A powerful symbol of hope for those it protects, and a relentless torment for its bearer. It compels enemies to focus their attention on the holder, who endures the crushing burden of infinite, searing agony.

items.name: Butter
items.description: A smooth, pale yellow spread that’s rich and creamy. It melts quickly, releasing a mild, slightly salty flavor with a hint of sweetness.

items.name: Cane
items.description: A wooden cane, without any magical properties.

items.name: Captain's Sword
items.description: A regal blade once carried by the Imperial Captain. Swings with heavy, precise authority.

items.name: Celestial Armor
items.description: Armor made with alien Celestial Metal. Its superior properties grant an increase in protection from almost any armor crafted with metals found in the Realms.

items.name: Celestial Axe
items.description: An axe of alien alloy, impossibly light and keen.

items.name: Celestial Bow
items.description: A divine celestial bow humming with astral velocity. Allows its wielder to loose a devastating volley of arrows in rapid succession.

items.name: Celestial Helmet
items.description: Helmet crafted from a metal not from this world. Offers higher standards of protection than any alloy made from ordinary metals.

items.name: Celestial Mercy
items.description: A Celestial Sword imbued with a fluid typically used as fuel for advanced Celestial ships. When ignited, the fluid emits a bright light but does not harm the blade, thanks to the unique metal of its construction. Deals damage in a broader area, landing hits even when they should miss.

items.name: Celestial Metal
items.description: An ingot made from recovered scraps.

items.name: Celestial Scraps
items.description: Hard metal with an impossibly high fusion point. Must be some kind of alloy made with unknown ingredients.

items.name: Celestial Shield
items.description: Shield crafted from a metal not from this world. Offers higher standards of protection than any alloy made from ordinary metals.

items.name: Celestial Sword
items.description: Sword made from an alien alloy, with a durability above every known material.

items.name: Ceremonial Cake
items.description: A grand, multi-layered cake with intricate decorations. Reserved for special occasions like the marriage of a royal, one of these cakes can feed a hundred guests.

items.name: Ceremonial Dagger
items.description: A blade crafted for the ancient rituals of the mountain Trolls. While its combat effectiveness is far inferior to that of a simple dagger, a lingering spell imbued in the weapon grants it power in other, more mystical ways.

items.name: Chain Link
items.description: Surprisingly light ring of unknown metal, seems to possess some magical properties.

items.name: Chain of Redemption
items.description: Light but very resistant chain that seems to reflect part of the incoming force, magical or not.

items.name: Champion Armor
items.description: "Further enhanced with part of the soul of the Primordial titan, this armor reached a perfect attunement with the wearer's mind."

items.name: Charred Heart
items.description: "A coal chunk vaguely resembling the shape of a heart, still weakly beating despite its condition, and the fact that it has been extracted from the owner's chest."

items.name: Cheese
items.description: "Solid milk derivative, ranging in color from yellow to orange. Its flavor is sharp and salty, and it's used in many delicious recipes."

items.name: Cheesecake
items.description: A creamy, dense dessert with a smooth, rich texture. Tastes incredibly good, and pets love this.

items.name: Cheese Risotto
items.description: Creamy, soft rice infused with melted cheese. It tastes mildly salty, with a smooth consistency.

items.name: Chief Scientist Coat
items.description: "An apparently simple coat that belonged to the brightest mind of Kaunis. It increases the wearer attributes in an unknown way that doesn't rely on magic."

items.name: Chocolate
items.description: Exotic food that only the upper class citizen of the Capital can usually acquire. Melts on the tongue releasing sweet, slightly bitter, and complex cocoa flavors with a creamy finish.

items.name: Cleansing Potion
items.description: A clear blue concoction able to restore the original properties of items degraded due to the corruption.

items.name: Cloak of Redemption
items.description: An intricate pattern made with magic chains is applied on a fire magic enhancing tunic, embedding the wearer in a protective field that reflects a part of the incoming force.

items.name: Cloth
items.description: A versatile textile usually employed in the production of robes or cloaks.

items.name: Cloth Robe
items.description: A light robe made of cloth derived from plants.

items.name: Cobweb Bundle
items.description: "Unrefined mass of Giant Spider's cobwebs. Can be refined into an unbreakable textile."

items.name: Coffee
items.description: Deep brown liquid with a strong, earthy aroma. Nutritional content is close to zero, but allows for cooking delicious recipes.

items.name: Coin Purse
items.description: "A purse full of coins of various denominations. Worth it's weight in silver."

items.name: Colossal Sword
items.description: The sword of a colossal titan, too heavy to be held by a common human.

items.name: Colossal Sword of Scarlet King
items.description: A colossal blade steeped in the flesh of the Formless Mother. Bloodflame yet clings to its edge, burning within wounds that refuse to close.

items.name: Construct Egg
items.description: Egg that will hatch a pet Construct. Constructs usually like to use magic to impair enemies and illuminate dark areas.

items.name: Containment Orb
items.description: Glass orb reinforced by magic, needed to contain powerful but dangerous artifacts.

items.name: Cookie
items.description: Golden and slightly crispy chocolate sweet with a soft, chewy center. A refined food destined to the breakfast of nobles, ambassadors and rich merchants.

items.name: Copper Armor
items.description: A heavy armor made of copper held together with leather straps.

items.name: Copper Axe
items.description: A simple axe forged from copper, sturdy enough to fell timber and foes alike.

items.name: Copper Helmet
items.description: Regular helmet made with copper for some extra protection.

items.name: Copper Ingot
items.description: An ingot made of copper. Can be smelted in any shape to produce all kinds of equipment.

items.name: Copper Ore
items.description: A malleable metal with a distinctive reddish-brown hue.

items.name: Iron Sword
items.description: A standard iron sword commonly used throughout the Realms.

items.name: Corrupted Axe
items.description: An Enforcer's axe, warped by a dark corruption that devours the light.

items.name: Corrupted Dagger
items.description: A dagger of fine making, rendered useless by the curse of the Serpent.

items.name: Corrupted Shield
items.description: The integrity of this shield has been severely impaired by the curse of the Serpent.

items.name: Corrupted Staff
items.description: A staff built by expert hands, rendered useless by the curse of the Serpent.

items.name: Corsair Leather
items.description: Exotic kind of leather that comes from processed Monkey Hide.

items.name: Cosmic Violin
items.description: A violin as old as time itself, played by ancient horrors during their abject rituals.

items.name: Cottontail Fur
items.description: The fur of the elusive Golden Rabbit.

items.name: Cottontail Jacket
items.description: Simple jacket padded with the elusive Golden Rabbit fur.

items.name: Crimson Brew
items.description: A thick potion displaying a vivid red color.

items.name: Crimson Leech
items.description: Corrupted with an otherworldly force bound by an alchemist through forbidden rituals, grants the holder a fragment of the power of the Unholy Serpent.

items.name: Crusader Insigna
items.description: The woven seal of the Crusaders of the Eastern Kingdom. A symbol of hope for their people, heralding light in their darkest moments.

items.name: Crushing Depth
items.description:
"Further enhanced with more refined electrical artifacts and with a string able to withstand extreme weight. Enemies often lose their balance due to the sheer strength of its arrows.
STUN: the unit skips its turn"

items.name: Crystal Dagger
items.description: With a blade derived from an original Frost Crystal, inflicts tremendous damage when striking vulnerable points.

items.name: Crystal Staff
items.description: Built from the remains of an Ice Elemental, this superior staff has the additional property of making the holder resistant to harmful statuses.

items.name: Cunning Demise
items.description:
"This armor components, harmonized by a central magical seal to build the most disruptive interference, modifies the properties of the air around to make transmission of sound impossible, hindering spellcasters effectiveness.
SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana"

items.name: Cunning Downfall
items.description:
"This armor components can vibrate so fast they disrupt the propagation of sound in the air, making spellcasters unable to cast their spells.
SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana"

items.name: Cursed Bow
items.description: Made from a metal displaying unique properties, this bow can be used with a speed unmatched by any other.

items.name: Cursed Claws
items.description:
"Forged from a metal worn by undead beings for unfathomable time, will open a grievous wound on an enemy with the slightest touch. The attack has to be melee for this to happen.
BLEED: the target receives 1 damage at the start of its turn for every charge, then removes one charge"

items.name: Cursed Helm
items.description: Forged from a metal worn by undead beings for unfathomable time, its sharp edges deter any melee attacker, promising devastating wounds to those who dare approach.

items.name: Cursed Jacket
items.description: Made with an ancient metal with unique properties, makes deep wounds inflicted by the wearer hurt even more.

items.name: Cursed Long Axe
items.description: A long axe steeped in cursed silver and redwood, festering wounds with venom.

items.name: Cursed Scepter
items.description: A terrible instrument when wielded by the right hands, this unholy weapon will raise walking nightmares from defeated enemies.

items.name: Cursed Silver
items.description: An extremely light chunk of silver that glows with an eerie light.

items.name: Death Ray Scepter
items.description: "A staff relying on celestial technology that can focus its ray into a thin, but perfectly aimed ray that hits its target with unmatched precision. An unknown device, inorganic but capable of behaving as a living creature, has been integrated in the scepter's mechanism to unlock its true damaging potential."

items.name: Decomposed Limb
items.description: The rotting limb of an undead creature

items.name: Deep Sea Jacket
items.description: Hides processed with reagents gathered in the depth of the ocean, to confer the wearer additional protection against external elements.

items.name: Deep Sea Robe
items.description: The velvet infused with deep sea reagents used in the weaving of this robe confers it enhanced protection against external elements.

items.name: Deep Sea Velvet
items.description: A piece of Exotic Velvet blessed with eldritch properties from the depth of the abyss.

items.name: Deviled Eggs
items.description: Halved boiled eggs with a yolk filling. The filling is extremely spicy, so this dish is not for every palate.

items.name: Diamond
items.description: A very hard gem that appears to be impossible to scratch. Only a handful of these have ever been found on the surface, making it an ideal gift for powerful kings or emperors.

items.name: Diamond Amulet
items.description: An elegant amulet adorned with a polished diamond, radiating timeless beauty.

items.name: Dino Ribs
items.description: Massive, meaty ribs with a thick, tender texture. Packed with protein, they make a hearty meal, but the ancient beasts they come from are incredibly challenging to hunt.

items.name: Divine Embryo
items.description: Painstakingly fed with a concentrated flow of consciousness, slowly the Ancient God is starting to evolve into another form. It is able to manifest additional powers, granting its keeper a wide range of bonuses.

items.name: Divine Larvae
items.description: Fed with the flesh of a nightmare beyond comprehension, the new shell of the Hidden God transformed once more, inching closer to its final form.

items.name: Divine Zygote
items.description: The remains of a being of endless power, who used their last drop of energy to restore its own mortal body into an earlier form. Unable to survive alone, it emanates an energy barrier of unfathomable strength, protecting itself and its keeper from the outside elements.

items.name: Djinn Tonic
items.description: A vial filled with the spirit of a slain Djinn. You do sometimes wonder whether it enjoys being a tasty drink, but the remarkable benefits of a sip now and then easily overshadow any ethical concerns.

items.name: Dreadful Morningstar
items.description:
"A terrible weapon taken from a nightmarish knight. When the holder hits an enemy it has a chance to inflict TERRIFY on them.
TERRIFY: The unit skips its turn and takes 20% max hp as magic damage."

items.name: Dreamcatcher
items.description: "An ancient accessory enhanced with a ritual by a long lost civilization. It's said to protect from evil spirits, and it provides a great experience gain boost to the wearer."

items.name: Dreamwrought Armor
items.description: Heavy armor made from a metal dreamt by a powerful being. Its ethereal nature makes it less hard than its alternatives, but allows far more mobility.

items.name: Dreamwrought Boots
items.description: "Made from a material dreamt and materialized by an otherworldly entity, these boots display surprising properties that can't be replicated with ordinary matter."

items.name: Dreamwrought Bow
items.description: Flexible bow made from an impossible metal frame, brought to reality by an otherworldly being.

items.name: Dreamwrought Gloves
items.description: "Made from a material dreamt and materialized by an otherworldly entity, these gloves display surprising properties that can't be replicated with ordinary matter."

items.name: Dreamwrought Hide
items.description: Hide fetched from a dangerous, colossal dream creature. Due to its origin it is very versatile, but less resistant.

items.name: Dreamwrought Jacket
items.description: Jacket assembled from materials dreamt by an otherworldly being. Sacrifices defense to grant a superior mobility to the wearer.

items.name: Dreamwrought Larva
items.description: The first stage of development of an insect materialized from a dream.

items.name: Dreamwrought Mane
items.description: The thick mane of a Dreamwrought Beast.

items.name: Dreamwrought Robe
items.description: An ethereal robe woven from cloth dreamt by an otherworldly being. Sacrifices resistance to grant a better intelligence improvement.

items.name: Dreamwrought Silk
items.description: Extremely flexible cloth woven from a dream like thread. Due to its origin it is very versatile, but less resistant.

items.name: Dreamwrought Staff
items.description: Ethereal staff made from an impossible metal, brought to reality by an otherworldly being.

items.name: Dreamwrought Steel
items.description: Very malleable metal materialized from a dream by an expert blacksmith. Due to its origin it is very versatile, but less resistant.

items.name: "Dryad's Blessing"
items.description: An average staff when considering its offensive potential, this intricate weapon really shines in the hands of an experienced healer.

items.name: "Dryad's Curse"
items.description: With a resilient Dryad hair running upon its edge, this weapon can cut through defensive spells like an axe through butter.

items.name: Duelist Armor
items.description: "Living armor in a synchronic communication with the wearer's mind, greatly enhancing their reaction times."

items.name: Egg
items.description: A smooth, oval shell encasing a firm white and a bright yellow yolk. When cooked, it becomes either soft and creamy or firm, with a mild, rich taste.

items.name: Elastic Boots
items.description: Sewn together using a mysterious membrane, almost unbreakable but able to be stretched beyond ordinary limits.

items.name: Elastic Membrane
items.description: A sheath of a weird material that could be either natural or artificial.

items.name: Elastic Robe
items.description: An unknown light, elastic material sewn in the shape of a robe. Offers great protection, without hindering the wearer mobility, which is vital for spellcasting.

items.name: Eldritch Mitre
items.description: This unholy relic amplifies one’s understanding of the universe to extraordinary levels, channeling ancient and forbidden powers.

items.name: Eldritch Scarlet Cape
items.description: The Scarlet Cape steeped in esoteric rites and sealed by outer horrors. Deep crimson threads twist with cosmic energy, multiplying critical destruction.

items.name: Eldritch Seal
items.description: The Seal of the Outer God, worn by his priests to show their unwavering faith.

items.name: Eldritch Shred
items.description: A fragment of a larger tapestry, it can be combined with other pieces to reveal the complete picture.

items.name: Eldritch Tendril
items.description: One of the tendrils of a Beholder. You can feel its powerful magic still flowing into the appendage.

items.name: Electric Catalyst
items.description: Arcane catalyst used to balance the properties of powerful, unstable elements.

items.name: Elixir of Affinity
items.description: Very difficult to brew even for the most skilled alchemists, made from ingredients of legendary rarity, this elixir acts as a neutral glue for substances that would otherwise reject each other.

items.name: Elixir of Learning
items.description: Magic concoction that briefly boosts the ability of a student to learn new concepts.

items.name: Elongated Bone
items.description: An unusually long bone, probably coming from a hind leg of a war hound.

items.name: Elysian Wood
items.description: An extremely rare wood found in a minority of trees in the Southern Lands. Seems to keep sprouting new branches even when chopped off the original tree.

items.name: Emerald
items.description: Precious green gemstone, widely employed in the field of jewelry.

items.name: Emerald Ring
items.description: A silver ring with an inset emerald, a precious stone carrying some magical properties of protective nature.

items.name: Enchanted Cleaver
items.description: A cleaver bound with a dense spell compendium, amplifying the force behind every blow.

items.name: Enchanted Staff
items.description: "An ancient seed from an Ent makes this staff a bit attuned to the holder's magic."

items.name: Enforcer's Axe
items.description: A once-corrupted axe, purified and marked with the imperial seal.

items.name: Enlighted Servant
items.description: A spark of light and a drop of darkness were infused in this empty shell, gifting it its very own soul. Having now achieved independent thinking, it is not faster, smarter, and capable of improvising in difficult situations.

items.name: Esoteric Egg
items.description: Egg that will hatch an Esoteric pet. Esoteric pets like to provide indirect bonuses, like granting enhanced learning, or finding more items.

items.name: Essence of Corruption
items.description: Pitch black potion distilled from the Black Ooze. When purified through additional steps, it can manifest unique properties.

items.name: Eternal Hunger
items.description: A powerful, ancient artifact. The wearer will never be sated in their hunger, but will gain the innate ability to consume the physical suffering of their enemies.

items.name: Evo-22 Vial
items.description: A refined celestial compound that stimulates biological evolution. Permanently upgrades an adventurer's common trait into its enhanced PLUS form (Brute+, Feral+, Bookworm+).

items.name: Evo-23 Vial
items.description:
"A mysterious liquid employed by the Celestials to permanently enhance their soldiers' combat efficacy. It directly manipulates organic tissues, inducing extraordinary structural modifications.
This item can modify an adventurer rare trait."

items.name: Evo-23 Vial
items.description: This item can modify an adventurer rare trait.

items.name: Exalted Powder
items.description: Alchemic powder enriched to display new magical properties. Only this powder is pure enough to be merged with the Primordial, increasing its strength.

items.name: Exotic Boots
items.description: Durable but comfortable boots made with soft velvet.

items.name: Exotic fruit Salad
items.description: Complemented with pineapple pieces, this fruit salad is juicy, sweet, and tangy, offering a burst of tropical flavors.

items.name: Exotic Robe
items.description: Woven with Velvet imported by pirates, these robes are sought after by all the mages and nobles in the highest spheres.

items.name: Exotic Velvet
items.description: Very smooth and prestigious textile imported by pirates from distant lands.

items.name: Eye of the Abyss
items.description: "Seeing its dimensions makes you wonder what kind of monsters lurk in the ocean's depth. Powerful and very rare alchemic ingredient."

items.name: Eye of Ur
items.description: A gift from a distant world.

items.name: Eyes of the Swordsman
items.description: "The eyes of the first general of the Sha'huri Army. A unique battle trophy."

items.name: Fang Dagger
items.description: A dagger made with a huge wolf fang in place of the blade.

items.name: Feather
items.description: A very light feather with a variety of uses.

items.name: Feather Robe
items.description: A light robe made of feathers, displaying the color of the desert birds.

items.name: Fire Catalyst
items.description: Arcane catalyst used to balance the properties of powerful, unstable elements.

items.name: Fireproof Oil
items.description: An oil obtained through unknown means that allow anything covered in it to be immune to fire.

items.name: Flake of Infinity
items.description: A piece of an incredibly powerful being, that somehow crossed the threshold between the mortal world and something else.

items.name: Fleetfoot Armor
items.description: Heavy armor padded with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.

items.name: Fleetfoot Boots
items.description: Boots made with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.

items.name: Fleetfoot Fabric
items.description: A magic textile enchanted by unknown rituals. Grants the wearer a reduction in its weight.

items.name: Fleetfoot Gloves
items.description: Gloves made with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.

items.name: Fleetfoot Jacket
items.description: Jacket padded with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.

items.name: Fleetfoot Robe
items.description: Light robe made with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.

items.name: Flute
items.description: A finely crafted flute, the work of master artisans from the Golden City.

items.name: Flux Limiter
items.description: An organic mass of nerves and tendrils, shaped to have specific optic properties.

items.name: Flying Reaper
items.description: This flying knife can be thrown to enemies, and recalled with a single gesture.

items.name: Focused Scepter
items.description: "A magic staff built with an alien alloy, integrated with an organic construct able to focalize the energy released into a ray as thin as a hair. While not as powerful as many alternatives, this staff completely nullifies any dispersion of the caster's energy."

items.name: Fresh salmon
items.description: A vibrant pink-orange fish with a firm, yet tender meat. Fished in the waters just above Blackwater Port, its taste is rich, buttery, and slightly sweet, with a moist, flaky texture when cooked.

items.name: Fresh Tuna
items.description: Deep red, firm flesh that’s meaty and dense. Valuable fish rarely found in the high seas, it has a clean, mild flavor with a slight hint of salt.

items.name: Frost Crystal
items.description: An extremely sharp crystal displaying minor magical properties. Despite its nature, it never melts.

items.name: Frostmetal Armor
items.description: The hardest frostmetal coupled with trollskin paddings give this armor an extreme durability, while gifting the wearer with an increased regeneration.

items.name: Frostmetal Axe
items.description: An axe cast from frostmetal, cold to the touch and ringing like winter wind.

items.name: Frostmetal Dagger
items.description: Dagger made with the coldest Frostmetal.

items.name: Frostmetal Ingot
items.description: An ingot of a peculiar type of metal that mixes the properties of iron and ice.

items.name: Frostmetal Ore
items.description: A raw piece of very strong and cold metal. Can be smelted into ingots.

items.name: Frostmetal Sword
items.description: Thick, heavy sword made from the coldest Frostmetal.

items.name: Frost Nucleus
items.description: The magic pebble around which an Ice Elemental can form.

items.name: Frozen Breath Broth
items.description: A cold, misty soup with an icy, translucent appearance. The broth helps to make the Wyvern meat more tender, but chewing it is still a daunting task for many.

items.name: Frozen Egg
items.description: "The egg of a Snow Wyvern. It's unique properties seem to increase the danger cold weather poses to those around it."

items.name: Frozen Egg Pendant
items.description: Encapsulates an authentic Frozen Wivern egg. Every ice damage inflicted by the owner will be amplified by the unborn creature still living inside.

items.name: Frozen Embrace
items.description:
"Enhanced with powerful ice magic, every attacker who touch this armor will be feeling its freezing nature.
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn."

items.name: Frozen Long Axe
items.description: A long axe sheathed in rime, freezing whatever it strikes.

items.name: Frozen Scale
items.description: A scale of the fearsome Snow Wyvern. Always a few degrees lower than room temperature.

items.name: Fruit Salad
items.description: A colorful mix of fresh, juicy fruits, sweet and with a soft bite and a vibrant, refreshing flavor.

items.name: Fullmoon Dagger
items.description: Dagger that uses the tooth of a wolf as a blade. However, this particular tooth seems to exhibit some weird properties.

items.name: Gem of Protection
items.description: Stabilized gem that projects a force field, adding a layer of protection on the owner.

items.name: Geode
items.description: Hollow rock that contains a precious gem. Rarely, they can contain a massive amount of gems.

items.name: Ghastly Cuirass
items.description: Heavy chest armor infused with an otherworldly substance, able to attract the enemies attention.

items.name: Ghastly Scimitar
items.description: With a consciousness enhanced by undead spirits, this living sword reacts with heightened speed.

items.name: Ghastly Shield
items.description: "Shield made on skulls and bones infused with a spectral essence of uncertain origin. Its own will is able to harm melee attackers in ways they can't conceive."

items.name: Ghost Rabbit Cloak
items.description: Light cloak made from ghastly fabric mixed with the elusive Golden Rabbit fur.

items.name: Ghostwood Board
items.description: Board of Ghostwood ready to be employed for the creation of various equipments.

items.name: Ghostwood Bow
items.description: Resilient bow made of ghostwood. The flexibility of this wood makes it possible to shoot arrows with a greater strength.

items.name: Ghostwood Shield
items.description: Shield made of ancient, refined ghostwood planks.

items.name: Ghostwood Stump
items.description: "Ghostwood replacement for a lost leg, a common occurrence in the pirate's world."

items.name: Giant Moth Wing
items.description: A moth wing of unusual dimensions, possesses greater elasticity than its smaller counterparts.

items.name: Giant Shell Fragment
items.description: A piece of an extremely hard shell.

items.name: Gift of Light
items.description: A mysterious reagent gifted by a god of light.

items.name: Glass
items.description: Sand heated to form transparent, smooth surface.

items.name: Glass Knife
items.description: A sharp dagger with an edge made of glass.

items.name: Glazed Donut
items.description: A soft, fluffy ring of dough coated in a glossy, sugary glaze. Popular among the north-eastern settlers, the exact recipe is not known.

items.name: Golden Armor
items.description: Standard, high quality equipment issued to the Empire Army soldiers.

items.name: Golden Axe
items.description: A gleaming axe of pure gold, a symbol of wealth and crushing authority.

items.name: Golden Boots
items.description: Boots made of gold, worn by the Imperial Army infantry and archers.

items.name: Golden Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets made of gold, worn by the Imperial Army infantry and archers.

items.name: Golden Helm
items.description: Helm made of gold, worn by the Imperial Army infantrymen.

items.name: Golden Shield
items.description: Shield made of gold, worn by the Imperial Army infantrymen.

items.name: Golden Sword
items.description: Superior swords issued to the Imperial Army infantry.

items.name: Gold Ingot
items.description: A precious metal widely employed in the production of high-grade military equipment for the Imperial Army.

items.name: Gold Scraps
items.description: Scraps of gold retrieved from broken equipment. Can be smelted into ingot.

items.name: Gourmet Icecream
items.description: "An experimental way of serving a cold , sweet flavoured cream. It's a rare speciality only a few select food lovers ever had a chance to taste."

items.name: Grains
items.description: A small bag of dry kernels with various shapes and colors. They have a slightly chewy texture when cooked and a neutral, earthy flavor.

items.name: Green Slime
items.description: Green, transparent jelly that makes up the body of Slimes.

items.name: Grilled Cheese
items.description: Golden, crispy bread surrounds melted, gooey cheese. The sandwich is warm and rich, with a satisfying crunch and a creamy, salty interior.

items.name: Heart of Darkness
items.description: The heart of a being predating existence itself. An expression of hatred unmatched by anything else.

items.name: Heaven and Hell
items.description: The epitome of experimental, nouvelle cuisine. A taco using the hard Wyvern meat as filling, completed with the hottest sauce in the realms. A unique experience for sure, but definitely not for everyone.

items.name: Hellish Rations
items.description: A dark, revolting soup with an eye floating in it. You can’t tell if the eye fell in by accident or if it’s part of the recipe. It looks vile, and there’s only one way to find out if it will kill you.

items.name: Holy Water
items.description: Water blessed with a secret ritual by a bishop of the capital. Can be used to remove curses from items or living creatures, but due to the length of the rituals involved in its production only the most wealthy individuals can afford it.

items.name: Ice Cage
items.description:
"Incredibly hard and cold armor enhanced with rare reagents from the coldest mountains of the Realm. Will FREEZE attackers on contact.
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn."

items.name: Ice Catalyst
items.description: Arcane catalyst used to balance the properties of powerful, unstable elements.

items.name: Ice Fiber
items.description: A thin thread of ice-like textile, likely made with a technique only known to the Trolls.

items.name: Icicle
items.description:
"Staff built around an ice magic generator, enhancing the holder's magic with the power of frost.
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn."

items.name: Ignition Orb
items.description: A river of Aether dances and twists in beautiful patterns inside the orb, contained by a powerful magic. Any caster with a good experience in the field of fire magic can tap into the Aether contained within to increase the temperature of their flames.

items.name: Imperial Shield
items.description: Decorated kite shield employed by the higher generals of the Empire Army. Engineered by the best blacksmiths to provide the highest standards of protection.

items.name: Imperial Staff
items.description: "A staff traditionally held by the powerful Imperial Mages, working with the Empire's army. Only the best pieces from the Golden City artisans make it to the battlefield."

items.name: Infected Blood
items.description: Blood carrying the mysterious infection that can turn regular undead into ghouls. Can be used as alchemic ingredient.

items.name: Infernal Bow
items.description: The heart of this unique bow has been replaced with Infernite, an exotic material that maintains its shooting speed while enhancing its tensile strength.

items.name: Infernal Chakram
items.description: The razor-sharp edges of this circular weapon, expertly forged from Infernite, make it lethally effective against enemies at any range.

items.name: Infernal Long Axe
items.description: A cursed long axe fused with infernite, poisoning and burning its victims.

items.name: Infernite
items.description: Mysterious mineral forged by the hottest fire, remarkably resistant yet light as a feather. Oddly cold at touch, allows to forge items with impossible aerodynamics, not reproducible with any other means.

items.name: Infinite Despair
items.description: Grants a premature end to both the wielder and their enemies.

items.name: Infinity Hat
items.description: "This mysterious headgear came out of a crack in the fabric of space and time. It's both stylish and powerful."

items.name: Infused Necklace
items.description: Necklace infused with a glowing liquid to confer it additional properties. Provides a small experience gain boost to the wearer.

items.name: Infusion of Wisdom
items.description: An oil that can be applied to certain armors or garments, able to boost the learning speed of those who wear it.

items.name: Insect Egg
items.description: Egg that will hatch a pet Insect. Insects usually like to attack enemies, and grant damage reduction.

items.name: Intercession
items.description:
"Allows an Adventurer to ascend without resetting their level.

Ascended adventurers gain access to Doctrines, increased base stats and an increased potion limits, but require twice the experience to level up."

items.name: Invisible Servant
items.description: "An invisible sphere summoned upon a small altar, once bound to cosmic powers but now loyal to its owner's will. It can carry out simple tasks, protect its master and unleash powerful attacks. Attacks from this source are always ranged, and magic."

items.name: Iron Axe
items.description: A dependable iron axe, widely used by woodsmen and recruits across the Realms.

items.name: Iron Chainmail
items.description: Iron rings woven together to confer basic protection in battle.

items.name: Iron Helm
items.description: The most common helm worn by regular soldiers.

items.name: Iron Ingot
items.description: A durable and resistant metal, usually employed to craft battle armaments.

items.name: Ivory
items.description: Smooth, pale white material derived from tusks of animals.

items.name: Ivory Jacket
items.description: Belt jacket enhanced with precious Ivory.

items.name: Jeweled Crown
items.description: Precious crown made with gold with inset emeralds and rubies. Amplifies the magical shielding properties of these stones to provide protection to vulnerable targets, while signalling the high status of the wearer.

items.name: Kabelian Armor
items.description: Armor donned by the leaders of the Crusade from the Eastern Kingdom, radiating light into the darkest corners of the Realms.

items.name: Kabelian Claws
items.description:
"Gloves forged with ancient iron, padded with a metal that shows psyonic capabilities. Vibrates in a way that allows to cut through flesh with extreme ease. The attack has to be melee for the effect to take place.
BLEED: the target receives 1 damage at the start of its turn for every charge, then removes one charge"

items.name: Kabelian Metal
items.description: Rare metal from the eastern lands. Displays some unique properties, likely coming from the psyonic ability of the people who smelted it.

items.name: Kaunian Fabric
items.description: "Thick and hard fabric displaying properties more close to those found in metal. Doesn't display any magical property, but will do an excellent job in protecting its owner."

items.name: Kaunian Robe
items.description: Extremely resistant robe woven from cloth employed by Kaunis elite troops. Grants increased protection to the wearer, but the lack of magic used in its making will reduce the boost to intelligence.

items.name: Kindlequartz
items.description: Cold at touch, this peculiar gem reflects light with a flame-like shimmer. Seems to draw the curiosity of the nearby wildlife.

items.name: Large Iris
items.description: An intact eye of a slain Beholder. Can be used as a perfectly focused magic lens.

items.name: Laroxian Boots
items.description: Light and resistant boots woven from a magic infused cloth produced in Larox, and padded with a magical cloth.

items.name: Laroxian Fabric
items.description: An incredibly resistant but light fabric, enchanted with a variety of spells to enhance its properties.

items.name: Laroxian Gloves
items.description: Light and resistant gloves woven from a magic infused cloth produced in Larox, and padded with a magical cloth.

items.name: Laroxian Robe
items.description: Light and versatile robe woven from a magic infused cloth produced in Larox.

items.name: Leather
items.description: A resistant but light material, usually employed in the making of armors or armor paddings.

items.name: Leather Boots
items.description: Common footwear made of leather

items.name: Leather Gloves
items.description: Basic gloves made of leather.

items.name: Leather Jacket
items.description: A simple jacket made of leather.

items.name: Leek
items.description: Long and cylindrical with pale green and white layers. Its flavor is mildly sweet, like a delicate cross between onions and garlic, with a crisp, firm texture.

items.name: Living Sap
items.description: The sap from a living tree.

items.name: Living Scimitar
items.description: A living weapon imbued with the spirit of a Djinn. Will sometimes act on its own, showing incredible mastery.

items.name: Living Vine
items.description: A long, resistant vine ripped from an ancient tree that moves on its own volition.

items.name: Living Whip
items.description:
"An unconventional weapon made with improvised materials, after careful research about the nature of the mysterious Dryad's hairs. Taunts enemies on hit for one turn, and has much greater range than the regular melee weapons.
TAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target"

items.name: Long Serpent Fang
items.description: A very long and sharp fang taken from a wild Spitfang.

items.name: Magma Shark
items.description: A steaming magma shark — an incredibly rich feed.

items.name: Mascarpone Cheese
items.description: Smooth, creamy, and white with a rich, buttery texture. It has a mild, slightly sweet taste and a velvety consistency that melts easily.

items.name: Maxxiburger
items.description: A massive, towering burger with layers of juicy meat, melted cheese, crisp lettuce, and savory sauces. Not very healthy, but extremely caloric.

items.name: Meat Chop
items.description: "A thick, juicy cut of meat complete with a bone. It's the cheap, nutritious base for most meat based dishes."

items.name: Meat Pie
items.description: A golden, flaky pastry crust surrounds a savory filling of tender meat. It’s warm, hearty, and packed with robust, meaty flavors.

items.name: Meat Stew
items.description: A warm, hearty mixture of slow-cooked ingredients. Tender chunks of meat float along with vegetables in the broth.

items.name: Meaty Mushroom
items.description: Soft and spongy with an earthy, mild flavor. Rarely found in the southern forests, where the damp climate sometimes allows for their growth.

items.name: Metamorphic Armor
items.description: Shapeshifting spikes poke out from this armor when needed, orienting themselves towards attackers.

items.name: Metamorphic Sand
items.description: Looks like regular sand at first glance, but displays peculiar shapeshifting properties.

items.name: Metamorphic Shield
items.description: Spikes will come out from this shield when needed, to hurt foes that get too close.

items.name: Milk
items.description: White and smooth with a creamy consistency. It’s mild, slightly sweet, and soothing. Can be turned into many derivatives, used in a large amount of recipes.

items.name: Missing Page
items.description: A single page of some old book.

items.name: Mithril
items.description: A legendary alloy, unbreakable by traditional means. Its creation remains a guarded secret of the dwellers of the Forgotten Lands.

items.name: Mithril Bow
items.description: An incredibly light and resistant bow crafted from the legendary Mithril.

items.name: Mithril Dagger
items.description: An incredibly light and resistant dagger crafted from the legendary Mithril.

items.name: Mithril Helm
items.description: An incredibly light and resistant helm crafted from the legendary Mithril.

items.name: Mithril Shield
items.description: An incredibly light and resistant shield crafted from the legendary Mithril.

items.name: Mithril Sword
items.description: An incredibly light and resistant sword crafted from the legendary Mithril.

items.name: Mitre Hat
items.description: A head covering traditionally worn by the Golden City priests. This hat, blessed with an ancient ritual exclusive to their creed, amplifies all healing spells cast by the wearer.

items.name: Molten Slayer
items.description: A berserker's axe drenched in infernite, searing every wound it opens.

items.name: Molten Staff
items.description: A poorly contained fire magic engine allows mages to channel their powers through this staff, albeit inaccurately.

items.name: Monkey Hide
items.description: The hide of a Capuchin Monkey, a small primate usually kept as pet and assistant by some Skull Island pirates.

items.name: Monkey Hide Jacket
items.description: Very flexible and resilient armor made with monkey hides.

items.name: Moth Robe
items.description: Resistant but very light robe made from the wings of a Giant Moth.

items.name: Mottiphobia
items.description: "The blade of this dagger is colonized with small flying critters gathered from an ethereal dream. They will help the holder by swarming a random target, dealing a ranged attack with damage equal to the holder's HP."

items.name: Mushroom Omelette
items.description: A fluffy, golden omelette filled with tender mushrooms. It’s soft and savory, with a rich flavor and a slightly creamy texture.

items.name: Mushroom Risotto
items.description: Creamy rice with tender Meaty Mushrooms. A very esteemed dish, given the difficulty of importing this kind of mushrooms in the northern cities even prior to the corruption.

items.name: Mushroom Stew
items.description: A warm, earthy dish filled with tender mushrooms. The broth is thick and flavorful, with a slightly spongy texture.

items.name: Mutant Hide
items.description: Extremely thick skin from a creature mutated through horrifying experiments. Hard to adapt to the human body, but impenetrable with conventional weapons.

items.name: Mutant Jacket
items.description: Jacket made from a monster mutated through the use of alien technology. Extremely resistant at the cost of a lower mobility.

items.name: Mutual Despair
items.description: Grants a swift demise in skilled hands, demanding a painful toll from its wielder in return.

items.name: Mysterious Appendage
items.description: The viscid limb taken from a deep sea monster.

items.name: Mysterious Cog
items.description: A simple brass cog. No one knoes its exact function, or can explain the immense power it contains.

items.name: Mythic Egg
items.description: A legendary egg infused with ancient power. It shimmers with otherworldly energy, holding mythical beasts of legend within.

items.name: Nightwing Jacket
items.description: Made with a type of leather that comes from giant bats rarely found in very deep caverns, allows for superior mobility and protection.

items.name: Nightwing Leather
items.description: High end leather sought after in all the Realms. Retrieving this material is so dangerous that only few people have ever owned it.

items.name: Nil Armor
items.description: An incredibly resistant armor, coated with the flesh of a Slime God. Will grant an unmatched protection to the wearer.

items.name: Nil Pendant
items.description: Perfected with the goo taken from a god of the slimes, this amulet will grant an unmatched learning boost to the wearer.

items.name: Oblivion
items.description:
"This unforgiving weapons is imbued with the very essence of darkness. It shoots arrows with unmatched strength, often STUNNING the target it hits.
STUN: the unit skips its turn"

items.name: Obsidian Axe
items.description: A razor-sharp axe knapped from a single block of volcanic glass.

items.name: Obsidian Bow
items.description: "Sculpted from a single obsidian block, this unusual bow's weight is even more balanced than the classical, wooden ones."

items.name: Obsidian Chunk
items.description: Dark, reflective stone famous for its durability, and sharpness when broken into pieces.

items.name: Obsidian Cuirass
items.description: Very heavy chest armor that grants the wearer with the highest levels of protection.

items.name: Obsidian Dagger
items.description: Extremely sharp weapon with a blade in Obsidian.

items.name: Obsidian Helm
items.description: A thick helm made of obsidian, extremely hard to break with conventional weapons.

items.name: Obsidian Scepter
items.description: "Perfectly balanced scepter sculpted from obsidian, offers minimal resistance to the owner's flow of magic."

items.name: Obsidian Shield
items.description: Big, heavy shield made in obsidian. Offers a degree of protection vastly superior than the more common ones.

items.name: Obsidian Sword
items.description: A double edged sword made with the sharpest stone. Can inflict terrible wounds with one swing.

items.name: Omni-Sever
items.description: A golden axe imbued with prismatic essence, wielding frost, flame and lightning at once.

items.name: Orb of Ectoplasm
items.description: An orb of otherworldly matter, stirring upon itself in an endless dance.

items.name: Orichalcum Armor
items.description: "Incredibly resistant armor made from Orichalcum, an unbreakable metal. While this material offers the best available protection, It may limit the wearer's mobility."

items.name: Orichalcum Dagger
items.description: An extremely sharp blade crafted from an unbreakable metal from another world.

items.name: Orichalcum Helm
items.description: Made from a metal seemingly impossible to destroy, This helm offers unmatched protection to the wearer.

items.name: Orichalcum Ingot
items.description: Unbreakable metal from another world. Sacrifices malleability to increase its resistance.

items.name: Orichalcum Scraps
items.description: Pieces of an unbreakable metal that can be melted into ingots.

items.name: Orichalcum Shield
items.description: Made from a metal seemingly impossible to destroy, this shield offers unmatched protection to the wearer.

items.name: Orichalcum Sword
items.description: A large sword made from Orichalcum, an unbreakable metal from another world.

items.name: Panopticon Staff
items.description: "Aligned Beholder irises allows for the dispersion of light from the caster's spells to be focused with a constructive interference, producing a large amount of light."

items.name: Pasta
items.description: Long spaghetti derived from grains, a common food found in many towns and villages. It provides a satisfying, slightly chewy texture and can be perfected with sauce.

items.name: Pasta with Sauce
items.description: Long spaghetti derived from grains, a common food found in many towns and villages, coated in a bright red sauce.

items.name: Pastel de Belém
items.description: A traditional Portuguese custard tart in a crisp, flaky puff pastry, lightly dusted with cinnamon and sugar. A beloved delicacy that pets find irresistible.

items.name: Patrician Armor
items.description: A golden armor adorned with the elusive Golden Rabbit fur, worn in social occasions by high ranking generals and diplomats.

items.name: Pear
items.description: With a smooth yellow skin, their flesh is soft, juicy, and sweet with a grainy texture that will melt in the mouth.

items.name: Pearl
items.description: Perfectly round and with a smooth surface. Very prized material for jewelers.

items.name: Pear Pie
items.description: A buttery, golden crust holds a soft, sweet pear filling. The pears are tender and juicy, with a delicate sweetness and subtle spiced aroma.

items.name: Perch
items.description: A freshly caught perch. Pets love the taste.

items.name: Permafrost Core
items.description: Unstable core that instantly freezes everything around it.

items.name: Permafrost Essence
items.description: Stabilized Permafrost Core, can be used to craft powerful items.

items.name: Phoenix Feather
items.description: A feather plucked from the mythical Phoenix.

items.name: Phylactery
items.description: An artifact of enormous power, capable of replacing a bound entity in its demise. When held by an unbound entity, however, it greatly boost their ability to regenerate the health of their allies.

items.name: Phylactery Fragment
items.description: Fragment of a powerful artifact. Has something to do with death-altering magic.

items.name: Pineapple
items.description: A spiky, golden-brown exterior hides bright yellow flesh. It’s juicy, tangy, and sweet with an exotic, refreshing flavor.

items.name: Pirate King Tricorn
items.description: Hat historically worn by the highest rank pirate captains, whose thirst for blood is legendary. Made with both regular and enchanted velvet, to provide additional offensive bonuses.

items.name: Plant Fiber
items.description: A base ingredient used in the production of textiles.

items.name: Poisonous Flesh
items.description: The flesh of a mushroom that lives deep underground. It contains a strange poison with a paralyzing effect, and requires careful handling.

items.name: Potato
items.description: A starchy, oblong vegetable with a brown skin, considered a staple in the common villager diet. Its inside is soft, fluffy, and mildly earthy when cooked.

items.name: Potato Mash
items.description: "Smooth, creamy mashed potatoes with a buttery flavor. It's a simple dish enjoyed by every social class in the Realms."

items.name: Potion of Agility
items.description: Permanently increases Dodge Chance by 1% (additive).

items.name: Potion of Clumsiness
items.description: A liquid brewed through unknown means. Will reset the amount of Potions of Agility drank by an adventurer to zero. This cannot be undone.

items.name: Potion of Constitution
items.description: Permanently increases Constitution by 1.

items.name: Potion of Darkness
items.description: Permanently increases damage by [0.1 × Darkness] %.

items.name: Potion of Defense
items.description: Permanently increases Defense by 1.

items.name: Potion of Dexterity
items.description: Permanently increases Dexterity by 1.

items.name: Potion of Health
items.description: Permanently increases HP by 5.

items.name: Potion of Immunity
items.description: Permanently increases Status Immunity by 1%.

items.name: Potion of Intelligence
items.description: Permanently increases Intelligence by 1.

items.name: Potion of Magic Defense
items.description: Permanently increases Magic Defense by 1.

items.name: Potion of Precision
items.description: Permanently increases Critical Hit Chance by 1%.

items.name: Potion of Rejuvenation
items.description:
"Resets an adventurer to its base rank, preserving ascension status.
This potion should be used to correct mistakes when choosing a class branch. This is not a prestige mechanic, but an Adventurer reset."

items.name: Potion of Viciousness
items.description: Permanently increases Critical Damage by 2%.

items.name: Prehistoric Mixture
items.description: A strange amalgam of ingredients from the depths of the Forgotten Lands, seamlessly fused together and exhibiting unique catalytic properties.

items.name: Primeval Armor
items.description: Armor plated with the scales of an enormous behemoth, extremely heavy but capable of withstanding devastating blows.

items.name: Primeval Axe
items.description: An axe of elysian wood and primeval scale, radiating the fury of a forgotten age.

items.name: Primeval Helm
items.description: Helm made from the scale of an enormous creature, capable of withstanding the hardest blows without breaking.

items.name: Primeval Scale
items.description: The enormous scale making up the armor of a colossal Wurm roaming below the Southern Grove.

items.name: Primeval Shield
items.description: Shield made from the scale of an enormous creature, capable of withstanding the hardest blows without breaking.

items.name: Primordial Essence
items.description: The essence of a primordial being, commonly used as alchemic ingredient.

items.name: Prismatic Armor
items.description: Combines different types of elemental magic to provide an unbreakable defense, while neutering their individual elemental properties.

items.name: Prismatic Essence
items.description: Stabilized essence displaying a variety of colors, elementally neutral but radiating pure arcane energy.

items.name: Prismatic Pendant
items.description: Powerful trinket containing the essence of all elements. While not very useful in battle, it provides a very large boost to experience gains.

items.name: Pterodactyl Claw
items.description: Giant claw of a flying monster previously thought to be extinct.

items.name: Pumpkin
items.description: Vibrantly orange with smooth, firm flesh. They grow only in the upper caverns below the Gates of Hell, thriving in the Nexus artificial light.

items.name: Quartz
items.description: Hard, crystalline mineral found rarely in the deserts and prized for its beauty.

items.name: Radiating Nucleus
items.description: A powerful, magical device that can store an immense amount of energy. Serves as an engine for Laroxian constructs.

items.name: Rat Claws
items.description: Sharp, flea-ridden rodent claws capable of fast, pestilent scratches.

items.name: Reassembling Jacket
items.description: Jacket enhanced with a powerful rune through the manipulation of its ethereal aspect, often achieved using a powerful instrument.

items.name: Recurve Blade
items.description: "A peculiar recurve blade. Unusable in the current state as it's handle is missing."

items.name: Red Reaper
items.description: A small, wrinkled red pepper with a sinister appearance. Its taste is fiery and incredibly spicy, leaving a sharp, lingering heat on the tongue.

items.name: Red Reaper Sauce
items.description: "A fiery, bright red sauce with an intense, lingering heat. It’s incredibly spicy, not very nutritious by itself and it's highly recommended to not eat this alone."

items.name: Redwood
items.description: Peculiar wood from the far east, rarely found in trading points thanks to traveling merchants. Displays a characteristic red shade.

items.name: Redwood Bow
items.description: Resistant bow made of redwood, a light and flexible material imported from far away.

items.name: Reptile Egg
items.description: Egg that will hatch a pet Reptile. Reptiles usually enhance the team offensive capabilities.

items.name: Rice
items.description: Tiny, white smooth grains that, when cooked, present a neutral taste and a soft texture. Often used as the main supply for soldiers embarked in long expeditions, as it is easy to conserve for long times.

items.name: Ritual Blade
items.description: A dull blade, unfit for combat but designed for esoteric rituals to honor the mountain gods. Magically enhanced by the gems embedded in its handle, it grants its wielder healing powers.

items.name: Robe of the Archmage
items.description: A robe enchanted with powerful protection spells, usually worn by members of the High Council of Larox.

items.name: Robe of the Lich
items.description: A preserved, ancient robe taken from the cold body of a slain Lich. The blueprints for its making are now lost in time. Grants enhanced powers to the undead caster if its servants are alive.

items.name: Ruby
items.description: Deep red gemstone with a rich allure, and used to craft a wide range of jewels

items.name: Ruby Ring
items.description: A silver ring with an inset ruby, a precious stone carrying some magical properties of protective nature.

items.name: Rune of Power
items.description: Rune carefully engraved with great mastery into a simple rock, capable of increasing the power of a wizard by orders of magnitude.

items.name: Sage Armor
items.description: Armor enhanced with a powerful infusion, able to boost the learning ability of the wearer.

items.name: Sage Cloak
items.description: Cloak enhanced with a powerful infusion, able to boost the learning ability of the wearer.

items.name: Sage Jacket
items.description: Jacket enhanced with a powerful infusion, able to boost the learning ability of the wearer.

items.name: Salad
items.description: A simple mix of crisp leeks and colorful tomatoes. It’s light, crunchy, and refreshing, but not one of the most nutritious dishes.

items.name: Salmon Nigiri
items.description: A slice of fresh, bright orange salmon atop a small bed of rice wrapped in seaweed. A staple dish in the diet of sailors, pirates and sea merchants.

items.name: Salmon Roll
items.description: "A sushi roll with soft rice, avocado and fresh salmon. Hard to make since ingredients must be imported from very distant areas, it's considered a delicacy even in the richest cities."

items.name: Salt
items.description: "Small, white granules or crystals with a sharp, savory taste. While it's not advised to consume salt alone, it can enhance most recipes. It is also widely used to conserve foods."

items.name: Sandstone
items.description: A stone made of sand solidified into a stone-like block.

items.name: Sauce
items.description: A smooth, liquid or semi-liquid mixture derived from tomatoes, leek and a bit of salt. It adds moisture, richness, and depth to dishes.

items.name: Scanner
items.description: An unknown device made of flesh, metal and stone. Seems capable to detect movement without relying on light.

items.name: Scarlet Cape
items.description: A regal cape woven from tenfold Scarlet strands. Flowing with occult grace, it bolsters the wearer's physical and arcane agility while sharpening lethal precision.

items.name: Scarlet Debris
items.description: Crystalline shards sheared from a Bloodstone Colossus. Pulsing with violent, coagulated energy.

items.name: Scarlet Oni
items.description: A demonic visage forged from condensed Scarlet strands. Discarding conventional heavy plating, it surges with raw bloodlust that drives its wearer to strike down foes with brutal, crushing criticals.

items.name: Scarlet Oni Juggernaut
items.description: The apex manifestation of demonic Scarlet armor. Imbued with titanic resilience and boundless fury, it pulverizes enemy lines with devastating critical brutality.

items.name: Scarlet Shroud
items.description: The legendary Veil, mechanically enhanced using the parts of the mysterious Machine. It autonomously helps the wearer in its movements in a deadly synergy.

items.name: Scarlet Sigil
items.description: An arcane focus intertwining otherworldly eldritch power with the lethal weave of the Scarlet strands. It channels intense occult resonance to fuel endless spellcasting and lethal critical surges.

items.name: Scarlet Strand
items.description: Gift from an ancient divine force to its worshippers. Only a few exemplars are known to exist, and their strength and quality is legendary.

items.name: Scarlet Veil
items.description: Legends talk about unseen assassins wearing this Veil who were able to take over entire armies. Gifted from an ancient God to allow their worshippers to pursue its goals, only a few shreds of these artifacts exist by now, displaced all around the Realms.

items.name: Scimitar
items.description: "Sword with a peculiar, recurve blade used by the Sha'huri people of the Desert."

items.name: Scrap Metal
items.description: Pieces of metal that usually comes from broken battle gear. Can be smelted into ingots and recycled.

items.name: Seal of Claris
items.description: Magic seal of Claris, the rebel Cultist.

items.name: Seeking Glass
items.description: A jewel once worn by the Slime King, ensures perfect accuracy under all conditions.

items.name: Sentient Slab
items.description: A stone slab from one of the titans created in secret with a cursed ritual.

items.name: Serpent Bite
items.description: An eldritch artifact from another world. A tangible paradox allowing the holder to blend in more effectively with its surroundings, and allowing them to deal more damage the less they blend in.

items.name: Serpent Jaws
items.description: The jaws of a slithering undead monster.

items.name: Serpent Lunge
items.description: An eldritch artifact from another world. The holder blinks randomly between dimensions, making them difficult for enemies to target.

items.name: Serpent Staff
items.description:
"An eldritch artifact from another world. Significantly impairs the holder's control over white magic, but confers a the buff "FRENZY" for 3 turns to every target hit.
FRENZY: This unit deals 30% increased damage."

items.name: Serpent Sting
items.description:
"An eldritch artifact from another world. This crossbow generates tensile strength beyond mortal limits. While it delivers massive damage, the recoil STUNS the wielder for one turn after each attack. This effect cannot be cleansed, and ignores immunities.
STUN: the unit skips its turn."

items.name: Sha
items.description: Finally awakened with enough time and a strict diet, the Hidden God will serve its owner with utmost loyalty.

items.name: Shadow Bow
items.description: Infused with a Shadow Potion, this bow grants its owner the feats of a nocturnal predator.

items.name: Shadow Dagger
items.description: A blade drawn by darkness, turns its owner into a dangerous night hunter.

items.name: Shadow Gem
items.description: When a living being touches this gem, whatever their nature is, they are instantly drawn to darkness.

items.name: Shadow Potion
items.description: With a bright purple color, items can be infused to provide bonuses in dark areas.

items.name: Shadow Ring
items.description: A silver ring with an inset Shadow Gem. Grants superior reflexes.

items.name: "Sha'huri Bow"
items.description:
"A bow made with a process known only to the people of the desert. Arrows shot with it can rarely stun their target.
STUN: the unit skips its turn"

items.name: "Sha'huri Bow Frame"
items.description: "The bow frame used to make the renowned Sha'huri bows."

items.name: Sharp Rib
items.description: "A rib ripped from an undead soldier. It's well conserved and very sharp."

items.name: Shielding Cuirass
items.description: Heavy armor enhanced with an endless source of magic power, to shield the user from external influences.

items.name: Shielding Helm
items.description: Helm enhanced with an endless source of magic power, to shield the user from external influences.

items.name: Shielding Jacket
items.description: Padded jacket enhanced with an endless source of magic power, to shield the user from external influences.

items.name: Shield of the Martyr
items.description: Awakened by the exalted powder gathered from the Primordial, all this shield knows and craves is pain. It will force enemies to attack its bearer at a much higher frequency.

items.name: Shield of the Titan
items.description: An unbreakable shield of unknown making. Forces the holder to feel the sorrow the failed titans in the halls felt, attracting the attention of the surrounding enemies.

items.name: Short Circuit
items.description:
"Able to reproduce electric magic without tapping into any magic source. Will be thrown at a random enemy at the end of the turn, dealing damage and having a small chance to STUN them.
STUN: the unit skips its turn."

items.name: Sickle
items.description: A farming tool used to cut and trim

items.name: Silk Fabric
items.description: Luxurious, smooth fabric prized for its softness and sheen. Used to craft superior light clothing.

items.name: Silk Robe
items.description: Garment made with precious fabric, provides little protection but grants a wide range of movements.

items.name: Silk Thread
items.description: Delicate fiber used to weave the fabric of the same name.

items.name: Silver Ring
items.description: A simple ring made of silver.

items.name: Sinister Stabilizer
