items.description: A powerful catalyst used to clear the arcane properties of powerful artifacts that may be cursed, or magically bound to another entity.

items.name: Skeleton Key
items.description: "A strange key adorned with a skull handle. It's very cold to the touch. Looks infused with a powerful curse that amplifies one's power over death."

items.name: Skin Blender
items.description: Glove that replicates the dreaded Banshee strike. Will cut through your foes like a knife through water, inflicting tremendous damage with each strike

items.name: Skull Candle
items.description: An unextinguishable, grim lantern fused to the skull of a great warrior, still alive but harmless in this condition.

items.name: Slime Armor
items.description: Protective armor made with sticky, green slime that can dissipate the force of any impact, lowering their effectiveness.

items.name: Slime Jacket
items.description: Dissipate the force of incoming blows very effectively, but sacrifices some mobility.

items.name: "Slime King's Crown"
items.description: The crown of the legendary Slime King. Provides a large amount of extra experience to the wearer.

items.name: Slime Robe
items.description: Peculiar light equipment that sacrifices mobility to grant increased protection.

items.name: Soul Shard
items.description: Condensed fragment of the multitude of souls, crystallized inside the creature they inhabited.

items.name: Spade
items.description: A simple tool used for farming

items.name: Spectral Cloth
items.description: Otherworldly textile made with a glowing thread. Clearly not crafted by human hands.

items.name: Spectral Robe
items.description: Cloak made with mysterious, ethereal fabric of unknown origin.

items.name: Spell Compendium
items.description: A rare book given only to the most powerful Laroxian mages, contains all kinds of spells discovered by their people.

items.name: Spellwoven Hide
items.description: Skin of a creature conjured through a spell, persisting in this world after its defeat.

items.name: Spellwoven Jacket
items.description: Jacket made from a very resistant type of leather, produced by magical means.

items.name: Spellwoven Leather
items.description: Leather made from the skin of a creature summoned through magical means.

items.name: Spices
items.description: Colorful and aromatic, while not able to sate hunger by themselves, they can be added to a lot of recipes to emphasize their taste and appearance.

items.name: S.P.I.D.E.R
items.description: A mechanical set of legs operating on alien technology. Can move the user extremely quick, provide an extra layer of protection for the lower part of the body and will even kick nearby enemies.

items.name: Spider Boots
items.description: Thanks to the peculiar fabric from which they have been woven, those who wear them can move with extraordinary agility.

items.name: Spider Gloves
items.description: Made from the coveted Giant Spider silk, these gloves allow for superior mobility without sacrificing the safety of the wearer.

items.name: Spider Leg
items.description: Leg of a Giant Spider. Can be used as alchemic ingredient.

items.name: Spider Robe
items.description: Made entirely with Giant Spider silk, whose elasticity and resistance is unparalleled.

items.name: Spider Silk
items.description: "Made from an almost indestructible thread, this light material offers protection with minimal hindrance to one's movements."

items.name: Spiked Primeval Shield
items.description: An incredibly bulky shield made with the scales of a giant behemoth, can cause considerable damage to any attacker through the sharp tortoise spikes attached.

items.name: Spiked Skeleton
items.description: The skeleton of an undead monster, studded with very sharp spikes.

items.name: Spiked Tortoise Shield
items.description: A shield made with a Giant Tortoise shell with spikes attached, offers great defensive capabilities while hurting melee attackers with its razor sharp spikes.

items.name: Spirit Candle
items.description: A magic candle of mysterious origin. It never burns out, and cannot be extinguished with any known mean.

items.name: Spirit Tome
items.description: Otherworldly book found in possession of an ethereal being. Tells of tales from another plane, giving insight into different forms of magic.

items.name: Spitfang Jacket
items.description: "Made entirely with Spitfang's scales and padded with fabric made by Moth wings. Will allow for great mobility while offering extremely good protection."

items.name: Spitfang Scale
items.description: Light and resilient scale making up the skin of a Spitfang.

items.name: Staff of the Archmage
items.description: Powerful staff used by Laroxian mages. Using their extensive magical knowledge, this staff energy source was bound with complex spells into a high-energy state. The crafting process is long and expensive, and they are held only by the most powerful wizards.

items.name: Star Fragment
items.description: A fragment of a distant star, containing an immense amount of power.

items.name: Starvation
items.description: Enhanced with a drop of blood from a legendary individual that sealed the fate of thousand worlds. Inflicts an inconceivable hunger on the wearer, but will allows them to prey even more efficiently on their enemies suffering.

items.name: Static Core
items.description: Unstable core displaying an extremely strong electric field.

items.name: Static Essence
items.description: Stabilized Static Core, can be used to craft powerful items.

items.name: Steak Braisé
items.description: A slow-cooked, tender steak with a deep brown exterior. It’s rich and flavorful, with a slightly smoky taste.

items.name: Stellar Flare
items.description:
"Further enhanced by an ancient, long-forgotten ritual, this bow hits with the strength of a stellar crown's flare.
STUN: the unit skips its turn"

items.name: Stellar Staff
items.description: Infused with the essence of a distant star, this staff burns hotter than any flame known to this world.

items.name: Stew
items.description: A warm, hearty mixture of slow-cooked ingredients. It’s thick and comforting, with tender chunks of vegetables suspended in broth.

items.name: Stick
items.description: A crude wooden branch, barely shaped into a weapon. Every adventurer starts with one.

items.name: Strawberry
items.description: Bright red, heart-shaped berries with tiny seeds on the outside, known to grow in the southern forests because of the warmer climate. It’s juicy and sweet, with a slightly tart edge.

items.name: Strawberry Pancake
items.description: A light, fluffy pancake topped or filled with sweet strawberries imported from the southern forests. It’s soft and slightly sweet, with a fresh, juicy pop from the strawberries.

items.name: Strawberry Smoothie
items.description: A pink, creamy drink bursting with sweet, juicy strawberries. A common, albeit expensive recipe before the corruption struck, when the southern forests creatures were shy and peaceful.

items.name: Sunfire Core
items.description: Unstable core burning with the power of a small sun.

items.name: Sunfire Essence
items.description: Stabilized Sunfire Core, can be used to craft powerful items.

items.name: Sun Staff
items.description: "A fire artifact has been isolated into the staff's head, granting its wielder a better control on fire magic."

items.name: Swarmkeeper Armor
items.description: An ethereal swarm inhabits this armor, and will chew at the flesh of any enemy getting close enough.

items.name: Sweet and Sour Meat
items.description: Tender meat chunks coated in a glossy, reddish sauce and pineapple pieces. The flavor is a perfect balance of tangy sweetness and a mild sour kick.

items.name: Sylvan Blessing
items.description: The gift of light was bestowed upon this staff, granting it an exponentially higher power and ability to protect allies.

items.name: Sylvan Flute
items.description: An intricate flute, fashioned with a mysterious technique by the reclusive dryads of the Southern Grove.

items.name: Sylvan Mandate
items.description: Infused by divine light, this dagger embodies the will of the forest and grants its holder with the power to enact it.

items.name: Synapse
items.description: A small wire capable of conducting electric and thermal energy extremely well.

items.name: Taco
items.description: A crunchy bread slice filled with meat, cheese, and sauces. It’s savory and nutritious, with a mix of different textures.

items.name: Tactical Helmet
items.description: An alien helmet that integrates unknown technology to provide the wearer with far more information that the naked eye can perceive.

items.name: Tattered Hide
items.description: The decomposed hide of an undead war beast.

items.name: Terrorsaurus Fang
items.description: Giant tooth of a voracious creature found in the depth of the world.

items.name: Thaumaturgic Blood
items.description: Once infected blood drawn from a fearsome ghoul, it has been purified by a powerful reagent. Unlike the base ingredient, it displays powerful healing properties.

items.name: Tiramisù
items.description: "A layered dessert with creamy mascarpone and espresso-soaked cookies. It has a smooth and sweet taste, and it's extremely nutritious."

items.name: Titanic Might
items.description:
"Infused with the powder resulted from a successful, albeit unethical, experiment from the Cultist rebels. Every property of this bow has been enhanced, thanks to the unwilling sacrifice of their victims.
STUN: the unit skips its turn"

items.name: Tomato
items.description: Round and smooth, with a bright yellow color. Its flesh is juicy and slightly sweet with a tart, refreshing flavor and soft seeds inside.

items.name: Tortoise Armor
items.description: Heavy armor made with the thick, resilient shell of a large tortoise.

items.name: Tortoise Shield
items.description: Heavy, resistant shield made from giant tortoise shells.

items.name: Tortoise Thorn
items.description: A very sharp thorn broken off a Giant Tortoise shell.

items.name: Toxin Pouch
items.description: A small bag holding an extract from the flesh of a poisonous mushroom. While too weak to act on its own, it enhances existing poisons by introducing an additional mechanism of action.

items.name: Training Bow
items.description: An inefficient bow used mainly for training

items.name: Troll Hide
items.description: Hard as a stone but light as regular leather. Used to craft superior quality equipment.

items.name: Trollskin Jacket
items.description: Hard as stone while allowing for a wide range of movements, secretes an oil that hastens the healing of wounds.

items.name: Tuna Nigiri
items.description: Deep red tuna on rice, firm yet tender, wrapped in seaweed. A delicacy sometimes found in the diet of pirates and wealthy sea merchants.

items.name: Tuna Roll
items.description: "A sushi roll made with red tuna, avocado and rice. Hard to make since ingredients must be imported from very distant areas, it's considered a delicacy even in the richest cities."

items.name: Tunica Ignis
items.description: Slime robe infused with a fiery artifact. Maintains its original properties while granting better control over fire magic.

items.name: Tunica Infernalis
items.description: "Adding a fireproof coating to this unique robe allows to apply different enchantments during its crafting, since protection from it's own fiery power is no longer needed."

items.name: Tusk Necklace
items.description: Simple ornament made with boar tusks.

items.name: Undead Axe
items.description: A jagged axe fashioned from shapeless bone and grisly remains.

items.name: Undead Cuirass
items.description: Heavy chest armor made from undead remains.

items.name: Undead Gloves
items.description: Gloves made with undead remains. A little too sticky, but allows for a good range of movements.

items.name: Undead Greaves
items.description: Sturdy footwear made from undead remains.

items.name: Undead Helm
items.description: Helm made with undead remains. Offers more protection than more traditional ones.

items.name: Undead Jacket
items.description: Grim piece of equipment made with undead remains. Offers good protection against external attacks maintaining some mobility.

items.name: Undead Knife
items.description: A dagger made with a long, sharpened undead rib.

items.name: Undead Shield
items.description: Large shield made with undead remains.

items.name: Undead Staff
items.description: Made with undead remains, allows for some control over the flow of magic forces.

items.name: Undead Sword
items.description: A grim sword made with undead remains.

items.name: Unholy Axe
items.description: An obsidian axe desecrated by an unholy potion, turning enemy strikes against them.

items.name: Unholy Cuirass
items.description: The malignant aura surrounding this armor will harm any enemies daring to enter its range.

items.name: Unholy Potion
items.description: All living beings are naturally repelled by its smell. The antithesis of all that is good, conveniently condensed in liquid form.

items.name: Unholy Spellcage
items.description: Bound within this ungodly cuirass by a potent spell, the seal of the Ten Hells burns fiercely, swiftly dissolving any foe bold enough to draw near.

items.name: Unholy Sword
items.description: "Antithesis to all that is holy, will inflict damage to any enemy entering it's malevolent aura."

items.name: Unstable Gem
items.description: A gem that vibrates in its own magical frequency. These are the building blocks of the immense Laroxian Nexus, and will one day be correctly attuned and integrated into its design to amplify its power.

items.name: Unstable Staff
items.description: Magic staff that draws its power from an arcane gem of unpredictable behaviour. The energy released will vary greatly without a known pattern.

items.name: Upgrade: Market Queue
items.description:
"Permanently increases Market's queue size by 1.
Limited to one purchase.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

items.name: Upgrade: Market Time
items.description:
"Permanently reduces Market's sale times by 10%.
Limited to two purchases.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

items.name: Upgrade: Quarters
items.description:
"Permanently increases Quarters capacity by 1.
Limited to one purchase.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

items.name: Upgrade: Shelter
items.description:
"Permanently increases Shelter's capacity by 1.
Limited to one purchase.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

items.name: Upgrade: Effectiveness
items.description: Permanently increases Shelter auto-feed effectiveness by 10%.

items.name: Upgrade: Storage
items.description:
"Permanently increases Storage spaces by 1.
Limited to ten purchases.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

items.name: Upgrade: Tavern Capacity
items.description:
"Permanently increases Tavern's capacity by 1.
Limited to one purchase.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

items.name: Upgrade: Tavern Time
items.description:
"Permanently reduces Tavern's wait time by 10%.
Limited to two purchases.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

items.name: Upgrade: Workshop Queue
items.description:
"Permanently increases Workshop's queue size by 1.
Limited to one purchase.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

items.name: Upgrade: Workshop Time
items.description:
"Permanently reduces Workshop's craft times by 10%.
Limited to two purchases.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

items.name: Vampire Axe
items.description: An obsidian axe steeped in a crimson brew that saps the vitality of those it wounds.

items.name: Vampire Bow
items.description: Alchemic result of a long research, its arrows can draw energy from the wounds inflicted and heal the owner for a part of it.

items.name: Vampire Dagger
items.description: With an extremely sharp blade, has been enhanced to draw energy from wounded enemies.

items.name: Vampire Scepter
items.description: "Enhanced with a peculiar brew, empowers the holder's magic with the ability to return from the target as a healing force."

items.name: Vampire Sword
items.description: An Obsidian Sword that gained the ability to draw energy from enemies, restoring the holder HP.

items.name: Veil Breaker
items.description: A staple tool in the bag of the arcane engineer. Allows workers without the gift of magic to manually operate across the veil that separates the physical world from the Arcane Flow.

items.name: Veil Shatterer
items.description: An extraordinarily powerful magical artifact, capable of overcoming any opposing magical force. It is the only known way to directly interact with the Nexus Core.

items.name: Verdant Blade
items.description: An unusual dagger with a Spitfang tooth instead of a blade.

items.name: Verdant Boots
items.description: Boots made of a rare, extremely resilient type of wood. Keeps sprouting new leaves that have to be periodically trimmed by the owner.

items.name: Verdant Bow
items.description: Made of the finest wood in the Realms, this bow can withstand an extreme tension without ever breaking.

items.name: Verdant Gloves
items.description: Gloves made of a rare, extremely resilient type of wood. Keeps sprouting new leaves that have to be periodically trimmed by the owner.

items.name: Verdant Helm
items.description: Helm made of a rare, extremely resilient type of wood. Keeps sprouting new leaves that have to be periodically trimmed by the owner.

items.name: Vinegar
items.description: Slightly colored liquid with a sharp, pungent aroma. It delivers a sour, tangy taste that is perfectly suited for some of the more elaborate dishes.

items.name: Void Armor
items.description: Not fully understood in its properties, adding a void drop to an already stable mixture of elements seems to further enhance their properties, giving life to the hardest material known to exist.

items.name: Void Core
items.description: Unstable core surrounded by a void area where no regular matter can exist.

items.name: Void Crusher
items.description: "An enormous sword, so heavy that it can't be lifted by any human. Imbued with the power of darkness, it deals enormous damage."

items.name: Void Pendant
items.description: Enhanced with matter of complementary type, the neutral essence constrained in this amulet was enhanced beyond its natural limits. Provides an extremely large boost to experience gain.

items.name: Voltaic Shock
items.description:
"The power of this hook was increased by a core that can amplify and focus the electrical magic simulated within. Will be thrown at a random enemy at the end of the turn, dealing damage and having a small chance to STUN them.
STUN: the unit skips its turn."

items.name: Voodoo Doll
items.description: Permeated with an ancient, despicable magic, in the right hands this simple cloth doll could inflict unimaginable suffering to an unaware victim.

items.name: Warden Belt
items.description: Hard leather belt characterizing the outfit of the wardens of the Golden City.

items.name: Warlord Skull
items.description: "An intact skull of a renowned soldier, once leading it's ranks against the enemy."

items.name: Werewolf Fang
items.description: Something is really wrong with this tooth…

items.name: White Hair
items.description: A single, immaculate white hair.

items.name: White Slime
items.description: A white blob taken from the body of a one of a kind slime deity.

items.name: Wicked Cleaver
items.description: A cleaver so wicked it slips between worlds, its strikes veering wildly.

items.name: Wicked Scepter
items.description: A horrible weapon instinctively repelling all living beings, though no one can explain the cause of this feeling. When the wielder summons a minion, this staff will summon a powerful accessory bound to it.

items.name: Wicked Seal
items.description: እንደ ላይ እንደ ታች። አሥርቱ ገሃነሞች እንደገና ተከፍተው ይሆናል፣ በመሠዊያችንም እንደ ሁሉም ይበላሉ።

items.name: Wild Egg
items.description: Egg that will hatch a Wild pet. Wild pets usually provide strategic support to the team, enhancing health management and offensive capabilities.

items.name: Winged Ray
items.description: A gliding ray catch with firm, meaty flesh.

items.name: Wing Fabric
items.description: Very light and elastic textile made from the wings of moths.

items.name: Winter Boots
items.description: Extremely durable boots made with materials found in high altitudes. Confer extra regeneration to the wearer due to the Troll skin present in their weave.

items.name: Winter Cape
items.description: "The peculiar properties of the troll's Wintercloth allows to craft this very light albeit resilient light clothing"

items.name: Wintercloth
items.description: Despite being a very thin cloth, it isolates almost perfectly from the external cold.

items.name: Winter Gloves
items.description: Gloves that can boost the regeneration of wounds thanks to the oils impregnating their inner side.

items.name: Winter Helm
items.description: Very hard helm made with uncommon materials, can withstand blows otherwise fatal.

items.name: Winter Shield
items.description: Very hard but light shield made with metal and wood only found at very high altitudes.

items.name: Winterwood
items.description: Very sturdy wood from the only tree that can grow in sub-zero temperatures, the Winter Tree.

items.name: Winterwood Bow
items.description: Superior bow made with the elusive winterwood, shoots arrows with very high strength and precision.

items.name: Winterwood Staff
items.description: The peculiar properties of the material allows for good magic attunement, making it a prized possession among spellcasters.

items.name: Wood
items.description: Just a simple piece of wood.

items.name: Wooden Bow
items.description: A simple bow made of flexible wood

items.name: Wooden Buckler
items.description: Round, lightweight shield made of wood

items.name: Wooden Egg
items.description: Egg that will hatch a Wooden pet. Wooden pets like to help the team stay alive, and are rarely keen for harming enemies.

items.name: Wurm Blood
items.description: Blood drawn from a Wurm. Can be used as alchemic ingredient.

items.name: Wurm Scale
items.description: Very hard keratin scales covering the body of the desert Wurms. Can be used as plates to reinforce equipment.

items.name: Wurmscales Boots
items.description: Sturdy boots made with wurm scales.

items.name: Wurmscales Gloves
items.description: Sturdy gloves made with wurm scales.

items.name: Wurmscales Jacket
items.description: Made with wurm scales for increased integrity, padded with feathers.

items.name: Wurmscales Shield
items.description: Round, light shield made from wurm scales.

items.name: Wyvern Cape
items.description: Enhanced with real Snow Wyvern scales, this robe allows for an enhanced channeling of white magic.

items.name: Wyvern Chop
items.description: Few people manage to take down a Wyvern, and even fewer manage to bite through its extremely hard meat. The taste is described as very intense, and the meat as extremely nutritious, with a single bite able to sustain a soldier for a day.

items.name: XP Book (Tier 1)
items.description: Grants 10 experience to an adventurer.

items.name: XP Book (Tier 10)
items.description: Grants 100,000 experience to an adventurer.

items.name: XP Book (Tier 2)
items.description: Grants 100 experience to an adventurer.

items.name: XP Book (Tier 3)
items.description: Grants 1,000 experience to an adventurer.

items.name: XP Book (Tier C)
items.description: Grants 1,000,000 experience to an adventurer.

items.name: Yoghurt
items.description: Creamy and smooth milk derivative. White in color, it’s tangy and slightly sour, with a rich, thick consistency that varies from silky to dense.

items.name: Zapper
items.description: An experimental axe crackling with trapped static, built to dizzy its victims.
